units.goal: Introduce yourself and identify who, when and where in a simple arrangement.

grammar.explanation: Use 是 to identify a person or role.
Put the time and location before the action in these examples.

units.dialogue:
甲：你叫什么名字？
乙：我叫安娜。我是学生。
甲：我们明天几点见？
乙：上午十点，在学校见。
units.dialoguePinyin:
Jiǎ: Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
Yǐ: Wǒ jiào Ānnà. Wǒ shì xuéshēng.
Jiǎ: Wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn jiàn?
Yǐ: Shàngwǔ shí diǎn, zài xuéxiào jiàn.

assessmentNotes.examBoundary: The verified HSK 1 sample has 20 listening and 20 reading questions, with no writing section. These short lesson sets are not full mock papers.
assessmentNotes.speakingBoundary: Speaking is formative communicative practice; a written reflection is not evidence of spoken proficiency.
assessmentNotes.writingBoundary: Writing here is optional supported character practice. There is no minimum-character requirement and it must not affect an HSK 1 readiness judgement.
assessmentNotes.pinyinConvention: Word forms use lexical tones, including written nǐ hǎo; connected examples show common 一/不 tone changes. A tutor must model and check actual pronunciation. Proper names are supplied with pinyin.

tutorGuide.preteach: Read the two people’s roles and the meeting details before checking answers.
tutorGuide.baseline: Before modelling, give one short parallel oral or reading example and record whether support was needed. Do not reuse the reserved seven-day review.
tutorGuide.independent: Use the assigned practice once after teaching. Record the exact prompt, replay, translation or model supplied; separate supported completion from independent performance. Record whether pinyin was visible; pinyin-supported and character-only reading are different support conditions and must not be treated as interchangeable evidence.
tutorGuide.exitCheck: Change a person, place, time or quantity. Ask for one new response without showing the model; record the words heard or seen, not a general impression.
tutorGuide.delayed: Revisit with the different reserved tasks at the server-enforced seven-day point. Do not print or rehearse their answer key with the learner beforehand.
tutorGuide.recording: Use the existing task observation/evidence fields for specific support and errors. The pilot worksheet is a private tutor aid; no new learner database or automatic pilot judgement is introduced.
tutorGuide.readAloud: Read naturally at a consistent beginner pace. Record every replay; screen off the script during listening. Label tutor-read or device-voice audio accurately; neither is a reviewed human recording asset.

teachingStages.warmup: Retrieve 叫、名字、学生、明天. Ask the learner to give a new example and note any gaps.
teachingStages.teaching:
Model this dialogue and check meaning:
甲：你叫什么名字？
乙：我叫安娜。我是学生。
甲：我们明天几点见？
乙：上午十点，在学校见。
Teach 是 + noun and Time + place + action. Ask the learner to explain how each example works.
teachingStages.guided: Use the reading passage and listening script. Ask the learner to locate the evidence for each answer, then practise a parallel exchange together.
teachingStages.independent: Use the selected speaking and writing tasks without showing the reference guidance. Record any prompting. Longer writing may be completed after the lesson.
teachingStages.exitTicket: Ask for one new example that demonstrates: Introduce yourself and identify who, when and where in a simple arrangement. Record the evidence and one next step. The delayed review uses different material after seven days.

tasks.title: Introduce yourself and arrange a meeting · reading
tasks.prompt: Read the passage and choose the best answers. Use evidence from the text.
tasks.passage: 我叫小林。我是学生。大卫是老师。明天上午九点，我和大卫在学校见。大卫的书在我这里。
tasks.passagePinyin: Wǒ jiào Xiǎolín. Wǒ shì xuéshēng. Dàwèi shì lǎoshī. Míngtiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn, wǒ hé Dàwèi zài xuéxiào jiàn. Dàwèi de shū zài wǒ zhèlǐ.
tasks.reference: Tutor-only key evidence: Q1: 小林. Ask the learner to point to the exact supporting words in the passage; a correct guess alone is not evidence of understanding. Q2: 上午九点. Ask the learner to point to the exact supporting words in the passage; a correct guess alone is not evidence of understanding. Time and place are read directly; names are supported labels, not new vocabulary being tested.

tasks.title: Introduce yourself and arrange a meeting · listening
tasks.prompt: Listen to the script read aloud by your tutor or a Mandarin device voice, then choose the best answer.
tasks.audioText: 今天下午两点，我们在学校见。你的书在我这里。
tasks.reference: Tutor-only key evidence: 学校. Use the spoken time, place, activity or quantity explicitly given in this script. Do not infer gender from a voice. Record replay or translation support.

tasks.title: Introduce yourself and arrange a meeting · speaking
tasks.prompt: Tell your tutor your name and whether you are a student or teacher in the role play. Give a meeting time and place using a new role card.
tasks.reference: Hear the learner complete the task. Consider task fulfilment, intelligibility and tones, accuracy, range, fluency and register. Record the specific help given; a written reflection does not establish speaking proficiency.

tasks.title: Introduce yourself and arrange a meeting · writing
tasks.prompt: Optional character practice, not an HSK 1 sample-exam writing section. With the tutor’s model, copy or write one short sentence from this lesson; use pinyin for an unfamiliar personal name.
tasks.reference: This is LiANN formative guidance. Check whether the response fulfils the actual instructions; note character formation or spelling, relevant detail, clarity, organisation and language accuracy. Explain a concrete improvement and ask the learner to revise. Meeting the length requirement does not establish quality.

tasks.title: Introduce yourself and arrange a meeting · reading · delayed review
tasks.prompt: Read the passage and choose the best answers. Use evidence from the text.
tasks.passage: 我是李明。小雨是我的朋友。我们今天下午三点在超市见。我要给她一本书。
tasks.passagePinyin: Wǒ shì Lǐ Míng. Xiǎoyǔ shì wǒ de péngyou. Wǒmen jīntiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn zài chāoshì jiàn. Wǒ yào gěi tā yì běn shū.
tasks.reference: Tutor-only key evidence: Q1: 小雨. Ask the learner to point to the exact supporting words in the passage; a correct guess alone is not evidence of understanding. Q2: 超市. Ask the learner to point to the exact supporting words in the passage; a correct guess alone is not evidence of understanding. Time and place are read directly; names are supported labels, not new vocabulary being tested.
